scripts.test: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$npm_package_name vendor/bin/phpunit && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$npm_package_name vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-parity.xml.dist
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check $npm_package_name --exclude-directories=vendor,node_modules,tests,.github --exclude-files=.gitattributes,.gitignore,.distignore,.wp-env.json,.phpunit.result.cache,phpcs.xml.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,phpunit-parity.xml.dist
